caption:
Two i-dle members just became K/DA again. Where, and after how long?

Miyeon and Soyeon performed as Ahri and Akali at the League of Legends Worlds final in Brooklyn on Nov. 14, eight years after their first K/DA stage in 2018.

Sources: Riot Games (LoL Esports) · Korea JoongAng Daily
